english: The site chosen was an island at the entrance of New York Harbour.
text: The site chosen 接住上文需要找地点的问题，随后才揭示选址结果。chosen 放在后面相当于 that was chosen；The chosen site 也正确，不能仅凭前后位置就断言一种更强调挑选过程。
author: doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628
